{{Quote|My own invention; it will make the very air you breathe healing.|MHD-19|<ref name="Bacta Radiator" />}}
The '''Bacta Radiator''' was a medical device invented and utilized by<ref name="Bacta Radiator" /> the [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droid]]<ref name="MHD">{{SWIA|set=Return to Hoth|cardname=MHD-19|link=https://imperial-assault.fandom.com/wiki/MHD-19_(Hero)|archiveurl=https://archive.is/POnwy}}</ref> and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]]<ref name="Combat Override">{{SWIA|set=Return to Hoth|cardname=Combat Override|link=https://imperial-assault.fandom.com/wiki/Combat_Override|archiveurl=https://archive.is/UKIYL}}</ref> [[MHD-19/Legends|MHD-19]].<ref name="MHD" /> The device created an aura of [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] in the [[Atmosphere/Legends|air]]<ref name="Brave the Cold" /> that healed the individual breathing it.<ref name="Bacta Radiator" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Bacta Radiator was first mentioned in the news post [https://web.archive.org/web/20190608001604/https://www.fantasyflightgames.com/en/news/2015/11/9/brave-the-cold Brave the Cold] on [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [https://web.archive.org/web/20240518061724/https://www.fantasyflightgames.com/en/index official website] on [[November 9]], [[2015]].<ref name="Brave the Cold" /> It later appeared on the [https://imperial-assault.fandom.com/wiki/Bacta_Radiator Bacta Radiator] card<ref name="Bacta Radiator" /> in the [[Return to Hoth (expansion)|''Return to Hoth'']] expansion set for ''[[Star Wars: Imperial Assault]]'' released on [[December 23]] of the same year.<ref name="Back on the Ice">{{FantasyFlightGames|url=en/news/2015/12/23/back-on-the-ice|text=Back on the Ice}}</ref>
